target_customer: Mac users (free consumer app) and enterprises paying for work integrations and support
problem: Personal context is scattered across email, messages, notes and files, so assistants lack the context to draft replies or finish tasks.
business_model: Free open-source app, revenue from enterprise plans for work integrations and support
product_category: On-device personal AI agent for macOS

founders.name: Jesai Tarun
founders.background_notes: YC page: ranked among top AI developers on GitHub at 18, created the open-source Writing Tools app (30K+ users), hacked iPadOS onto iPhone 17 Pro. No education or employers listed.

founders.name: Aditya Vellanki
founders.background_notes: YC page states age 18 and that he shipped consumer products from age 12.

competitors.name: Rewind / Limitless
competitors.what: Mac memory and screen capture assistant, acquired by Meta

competitors.name: Screenpipe
competitors.what: Open-source local-first screen recording and memory
competitors.traction_then: Positioned as the main open-source Rewind replacement

technical_complexity.rationale: Runs a small local model on 8 GB Macs overnight and builds a knowledge base, plus computer-use agent features; demanding engineering but built on open models.

defensibility.rationale: Open source under AGPL and Apple or model labs could add similar features; the personal knowledge base adds some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet determinable; the company launched its Mac app in late October 2026.

market_need_then: Rewind's Mac capture shutdown in December 2025 left a gap in local memory tools, and users showed interest on Reddit; company claims 10,000+ users (inconsistent with 4,000+ on the YC page).

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and minimal: 'Computer use that already knows you', 'Your Mac, a little more sentient'

branding.brand_signature: Mac notch trigger and the sphere motif
branding.community_and_virality: Open-source repo with releases and Reddit comments from r/macapps and r/LocalLLaMA coverage

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with Sentient Labs ($85M, 2024) and other Sentient entities in search; early community interest only.

outcome_analysis: Sentient OS is a YC Fall 2026 company that launched an open-source on-device Mac assistant in late October 2026, after Rewind's Mac capture ended. It has early user interest and young founders with open-source credibility, but no verified revenue, and large platform players are the main risk. No exit or layoffs reported.
notes: Funding unverified: search snippets of the YC page and Caplight report about $1M pre-seed (2026-09-01) from YC, Afore Capital and the a16z Speedrun scout fund; I did not open a primary announcement, so no round is recorded. Sentient Labs ($85M) and Mirai are different companies. Founder education and employers not found.
